name: 3475-longdecode-tinyllama1.1b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, one in-process engine, no router and no cache tier outside the node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 1, bounded at 96 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup 5% so 92 requests are scored.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, fixed lengths on both axes (prompt 128, output 1024, no dispersion, no shared prefix), request_format plain so no chat template is applied, temperature 0.0, streamed.
purpose: A compact chat assistant drafting long-form replies from short prompts, streaming to one user at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 9fdf3de346836e88b310e53b50e7947974fde1d3 (vLLM 0.3.3 era).
# Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml (NOT portable).
# This era's AsyncEngineArgs raises TypeError at engine construction on an unknown key, so do not
# carry keys back from a later vLLM.
model: TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# The four below are this engine's OWN resolved defaults at this commit, written out so they
# cannot silently drift. Do not pin `max-model-len`: at this commit `max-num-batched-tokens` is
# derived from it, so pinning one changes the other.
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
block-size: 16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# `enforce-eager` is deliberately not set, so decode runs under CUDA graphs, the engine default.
